headline: BTG Pactual Files Request with Central Bank to Operate Regulated Crypto
summary: Investment bank BTG Pactual submitted an application to Brazil's central bank to offer cryptocurrency services under a regulated framework.
why: Traditional financial institutions expanding into regulated digital assets bridge institutional capital with blockchain ecosystems.

impacts.name: BTG Pactual
impacts.why: Regulatory approval for digital asset operations expands the bank's product offerings.
